title: Veterans Pension Recurring Countable Income on the Award
content:
# Recurring countable income on the Veterans Pension award

When a retroactive compensation release reaches a Veterans Pension recipient after his compensation award has ended, VA redetermines the recurring countable income on the award: the household's annualized income from recurring sources, before any medical deduction, rounded to the cent. One-time payments are counted separately at each rate determination and are not part of this figure.

| The figure | Is | Is not |
|---|---|---|
| Recurring countable income on the award | annualized household income from recurring sources, in dollars and cents | reduced by any medical deduction; inclusive of one-time payments |

What the redetermination books is the countable income figure carried on the award; the award's status, its payments and its other figures are untouched by it.

## Tool: `update_countable_income_81bdd26c`

**Capability.** It sets the recurring countable income recorded on a veteran's Veterans Pension award to a redetermined figure. One call replaces the award's countable income figure with the value given; no other figure, status or entry on the award changes and no payment is made.

**Invocation.** The agent unlocks `update_countable_income_81bdd26c` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `pension_award_id` | the reference number of the Veterans Pension award, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran | identifier |
| `annual_countable_income` | the redetermined annual countable income, in USD | decimal with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 is allowed |

**Return.** On success, one sentence of the form "Countable income on award <award reference> set to <amount> USD." with the amount shown to 2 decimal places. Receiving this sentence means the award now carries that figure, and the new countable income can be read back on the award. The tool defines no other outcome.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a redetermined figure of 24310.456 is passed as `annual_countable_income` 24310.46.
